examples.en: I got my hair cut at the salon.
I go to the hair salon on Sundays.
I'm going to the hair salon. I'm getting a haircut.
On Saturdays the hair salon is busy.
The hair salon closes at eight in the evening.

explain: 미용실은 머리를 자르고 파마나 염색도 하는 곳이에요. “이발소”는 주로 남자 머리를 자르는 옛날식 가게예요.
explain_en: A 미용실 cuts hair and also does perms and dyeing. A 이발소 is an old-style barbershop, mainly for men.

examples.en: The hotel room is very spacious.
Tonight I'm sleeping at a hotel.
The hotel staff are very kind.
That hotel is near the airport.
The hotel breakfast is really delicious.

explain: 호텔 말고 다른 숙소도 있어요. 게스트하우스는 여행자가 많이 쓰는 싼 숙소이고, 펜션은 바다나 산 근처의 집을 빌리는 숙소예요.

dict_examples.en: to check in at a hotel

dict_examples.en: to unpack one's luggage at a hotel
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 우리가 묵게 될 곳은 무궁화 네 개의 고급 호텔이었다.
dict_examples.en: The place we would stay at was a four-star luxury hotel.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 그녀는 조심스럽게 옷을 입고 슬며시 호텔에서 나왔다.
dict_examples.en: She dressed carefully and slipped out of the hotel.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: There are other places to stay. A 게스트하우스 is a cheaper guesthouse popular with travelers, and a 펜션 is a house you rent near the sea or mountains.

examples.en: The students are in the classroom.
What floor is the classroom on?
The Korean classroom is on the second floor.
Our classroom is very clean.

examples.ko: 학생들이 교실에 와요. 곧 수업을 시작해요.
examples.en: The students come to the classroom. They'll start class soon.

explain: 한국 초·중·고등학교에서는 보통 학생들이 한 교실을 계속 써요. 그래서 “삼 학년 이 반”처럼 학년과 반으로 말해요.

dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 선생님이 교실에 들어서자 아이들은 책을 펴고 수업 준비를 했다.
dict_examples.en: When the teacher entered the classroom, the children opened their books and prepared for class.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: In Korean elementary, middle and high schools, a class of students usually stays in its own classroom. So you say grade and class: 삼 학년 이 반 (3rd grade, class 2).

examples.en: What floor is the office on?
I get to the office at eight in the morning.
Our office is very quiet.
The new office is near the subway station.
There's a lot of office work. I'm busy today too.

explain: “회사”는 company이고 “사무실”은 일하는 방이에요. 작은 회사나 가게의 office도 “사무실”이라고 해요.
explain_en: 회사 is the company; 사무실 is the room where people work. A small shop or firm's office is also called a 사무실.

examples.en: I go to the bakery and buy bread.
My child is going to the bakery to buy a cake.
The bread at this bakery is really good.
Where is the bakery? — Next to the coffee shop.
The bakery opens at seven in the morning.

explain: “빵”은 오래전에 포르투갈어 pão에서 온 말이에요. 케이크와 샌드위치도 빵집에서 팔아요.

dict_examples.ko: 빵집에서 빵 굽는 냄새가 풍겨 나왔다.
dict_examples.en: The smell of baking bread wafted out of the bakery.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 빵 came from the Portuguese word pão a long time ago. Bakeries (빵집) also sell cakes and sandwiches.

examples.en: I'm going to Busan by train.
I'm going to Busan this weekend.
Busan is a big city in Korea.
The sea in Busan is really beautiful.
My friend is from Busan.

explain: 부산은 서울 다음으로 큰 도시예요. KTX를 타면 서울에서 세 시간이 안 걸려요.
explain_en: Busan is the second-largest city after Seoul. By KTX it takes under three hours from Seoul.

examples.en: I'm going to the convenience store in my neighborhood.
A friend is coming to my neighborhood.
My neighborhood is very quiet.
A friend from the neighborhood is coming to my place.
What neighborhood is this? — It's Sinchon.

explain: 동네는 집 가까이에 있는 작은 지역이에요. 서울 전체는 동네가 아니라 “도시”예요. 그래서 “우리 동네는 신촌이에요”처럼 작은 곳을 말해요.

phrases.example: 왜 다들 저한테만 뭐라고 해요? 제가 동네북이에요?
phrases.en: a punching bag; someone everyone picks on
phrases.nuance_ko: 아무나 와서 치는 북처럼, 모두가 탓하거나 놀리는 사람이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: like a drum anyone can hit; someone everyone blames or teases
phrases.en_equiv: a punching bag; someone everyone picks on

dict_examples.en: to hold a feast in the neighborhood
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 동네 is the small area near your home. A whole city like Seoul isn't a 동네, it's a 도시. So you say things like “우리 동네는 신촌이에요.”

examples.en: I'm going downtown.
I go downtown every Saturday.
Downtown is very crowded on weekends.
Hotels downtown are very expensive.
Are you going downtown? — Yes, I'm going shopping.

explain: 시내의 반대말은 “시외”예요. 버스에도 “시내버스”와 “시외버스”가 있어요. 시외버스는 다른 도시로 가요.

dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역
국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 그의 사무실은 시내에 있으면서도 참 조용했다.
dict_examples.en: His office was in the city center yet very quiet.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 우리는 택시를 잡아타고는 시내 중심가로 나왔다.
dict_examples.en: We hailed a taxi and came out to the city center.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: The opposite of 시내 is 시외 (outside the city). Buses are either 시내버스 (city bus) or 시외버스 (intercity bus, to other cities).
